id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data for the range of available dates.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

allowKeyboardEdit.description:
Whether to allow user type with keyboard or not
NOTE: Keyboard editing only support en_US locale
Meaning format dates as `MM/DD/YYYY, hh:mm`
Other locale should disable keyboard edit

showTimePicker.description: Whether to show time picker or not

timePickerStepMinutes.description:
The step minutes of time picker, unit is minute
if timePickerStepMinutes = 15, meaning time selector displays in 15 minutes gap
12:00 AM, 12:15 AM, 12:30 AM etc. and more

noTimeZoneConversion.description: Whether or not the dateTimeInput should be only in UTC time

dataCollection.description: Holds the data to set the range of available dates.

startLabel.description: Label to display above the start date.

endLabel.description: Label to display above the end date.

startPlaceholder.description: Placeholder to display for the start date.

endPlaceholder.description: Placeholder to display for the end date.

endDateInclusive.description: Whether the end date is inclusive when {@link UiSdlDateTimeInputBase#showTimePicker} is false

disabled.description: Whether to disable the start and end date inputs
